d:
David Bickford, Former Legal Director of MI5 and MI6, on spies, cocaine, and the laws intelligence agencies break to keep you safe.
He explains:
• How MI5 and MI6 actually recruit spies and what they look for in candidates
• What made him use fake passports during active intelligence operations
• How to become an intelligence officer search
• Why he believes London's cocaine problem is far larger than the public realises
• What happened when a British intelligence officer helped catch a Czechoslovak spy in his first UK operation
